title: Better SMP
description: A fabric pack to improve the player experience on a SMP Server!
body:
# StyleLabor SMP |  ![A minecraft "cartoon" grass block! - Logo](https://i.postimg.cc/CxtZqgcL/Ff7deae-X0-AEIt-L3.png)
A fabric mod collection to improve the vanilla experience!

This pack includes some performance mods and also quality of life mods to improve the overall game experience. 
Shaders can also be used with the help of the Iris mod. These can also be downloaded directly in the game, as can texture packs. 

### ![Voice Chat Icon - https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat/](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/423de1127f20dce3348b7aeac0570bf6c7c934f7.png) 

Also included is a vocie chat mod to talk to other players (of this pack, but generally all players with the same voice chat mod) on a server! 

In addation the pack will be updated time to time to ensure you gain the best performance and the newest features!
